body:
## Context

The context-rot handoff (spec docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md, package @adlc/context-handoff) currently ends at a session-terminal mutation deny: at the handoff band the adapter arms a deny marker (contentHash null) and every recovery step is a human at a TTY. No narrative handoff content exists anywhere — the "final" checkpoint (packages/context-handoff/lib/final.mjs buildFinal) is a six-field binding token. The program decision (2026-08-13, user-confirmed) is to automate capture -> signed consume -> fresh-session restart while keeping D1-D3, the denier-sticky D2, and host-side-only key use intact. The spec explicitly forbids successor spawn today ("fake chat spawn" under Non-goals) — this ticket amends the spec FIRST so implementation slices build against a binding design.

## What to change (docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md, then copy byte-identical to .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md)

Additive amendment; do NOT renumber existing contract tests 1-17; keep the spec's terse telegraphic style.

1. New normative section "Capture": content artifact `.adlc/handoffs/content/<session_id>.md`, written ONLY by host-privileged code (CLI/supervisor/hook-host), never agent tools; the protected-path list (adapter isProtectedHandoffPath + harness copies) must grow to cover `.adlc/handoffs/content/**`. Content = deterministic brief (active ticket id+title, gate-manifest evidence tail, git branch + status summary, flail signals when present) plus optional model narrative extracted host-side from the harness transcript (trailing assistant message). When a capture file exists, final `content_hash` = sha256 of the canonicalized capture body (falls back to current metadata hash when absent). Existing 72h written_at staleness rule applies to the model-narrative injection.

2. New normative section "Continue": `adlc handoff continue --deny-session <old> [--session <new>] [--capture-from <transcript>] [--write] [--json]` composing capture -> write (final + bind; ticket resolution: CLI flag -> .adlc/current-ticket.json pointer -> env-if-equal) -> resume for the successor id -> bootstrap payload JSON on stdout: { successor_session_id, ticket_id, content_path, content_hash, bootstrap_prompt }. Mutating posture identical to write/resume: --write + ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, denier session lock held, evidence gate `context-handoff-continue`, rollback on failed evidence append. Degrade (exit 2, nothing consumed): unbound deny (null ticket_id), missing/corrupt capture source when --capture-from given, or consumed deny. Successor id: supplied via --session or minted (ULID/UUID) by the command; never derived from agent input.

3. New normative section "Supervised-only auto-consume": only the continuation machinery's own minted/known successor id is consumed for; arbitrary fresh sessions never auto-consume; hooks never consume (keyless). This is the v1 policy — a config surface may relax later, not in this program.

4. Deny-set: `continue` joins write|resume|bypass|repair|unlock in HANDOFF_MUTATING_SUBCOMMANDS (package adapter + every harness copy).

5. Non-goals edit: remove "fake chat spawn"; keep host compactors; add explicitly: auto-consume for unsupervised sessions (v1) and warn-band model checkpoint are non-goals; in-place context wipe of a denied session is a non-goal (successor session only).

6. Contract tests: append frozen items 18-24 —
18 continue happy path consumes exactly the minted successor and emits the payload;
19 continue on unbound deny exits 2 and consumes nothing;
20 continue rolls back on evidence-append failure (deny stays open, no resume-auth survives);
21 agent Write to .adlc/handoffs/content/** denied on enforcing tiers;
22 content-hash binding: tampered capture content fails resume verification;
23 agent Shell invoking `handoff continue` denied under deny-set;
24 supervisor env-scrub: spawned successor drops CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT (harness slice).
Mark 18-23 as package-level, 24 as harness-adapter-level (same convention as the existing 1-17 split note).

## Acceptance criteria

- Amended spec present with the four new normative sections and the Non-goals edit. verify: `grep -q 'handoffs/content/' docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md && grep -q 'continue --deny-session' docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md && ! grep -q 'fake chat spawn' docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Contract items 18-24 enumerated. verify: `grep -q 'env-scrub' docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Mirror byte-identical. verify: `diff docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Spec lint clean. verify: `npx adlc spec-lint docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md` exits 0.
- Existing contract tests 1-17 text unchanged (additive amendment). verify: git diff shows no deletions inside the existing numbered list.
title: Amend context-rot-handoff spec: host-orchestrated continuation (capture, continue, supervised-only consume)
